name: The Fucker
description: On pickup steal all of Sam's points. Sam gets to choose another relic

name: BAIL ME OUT
description: On pickup set your points equal to first place

name: Bomb Vest
description: Choose 2 other players. Set all of your points to 0

name: Bomb Necklace
description: Choose a player. The next time they answer a question wrong set their points to 0

name: Brann's Rifle
description: Get double point gain and loss from answers

name: Nerd Emoji
description: Get double points from questions you answer second

name: Third Emoji
description: After you answer a question correctly and third, triple your points

name: New Stim
description: On pickup everyone loses half their points

name: Papaya Shirt
description: On pickup answer an Asher-related question, if you get it right get 10,000 points

name: Flipped Script
description: On pickup multiply your points by -2

name: Hot Hand
description: Whenever you answer a question correctly, you may answer the next one before anyone else

name: Belay Device
description: You can not lose points from answering incorrectly

name: Piece of Duct Tape
description: On pickup choose a player and a category, that player may not answer questions from that category

name: Stonk Device
description: On pickup choose a player. Their point gain and loss also happens to your points

name: X-Ray Goggles
description: You may look at the final jeopardy question before you bet

name: Zarya Bubble
description: Whenever you would lose points from another relic, gain them instead
